// diagnostic

L0206

`` `Shared.{method}()` keeps its lock through a long lexical scope ``.

What

`` `Shared.{method}()` keeps its lock through a long lexical scope ``.

Why

A `SharedGuard` releases at scope exit, so later statements and nested guard acquisitions run while this lock is held.

Fix

Move the guarded work into a smaller block. When nesting guards is necessary, acquire them in one stable order.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0206: tests/ui_lint/shared_guard_long_scope.warn.

Warning [L0206] (shared_guard_long_scope): `Shared.guard_edit()` keeps its lock through a long lexical scope
  --> tests/ui_lint/shared_guard_long_scope.jet:3:21
    |
  3 |     guard :: handle.guard_edit()
    |                     ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the guard releases at scope exit, so later statements and nested guard acquisitions run while this lock is held
 Fix: move the guarded work into a smaller block; when nesting guards is necessary, acquire them in one stable order
